notes:
Pi 1.5.0 has no default for `defaultProvider` or `defaultModel`, so they are always written when unset. `defaultThinkingLevel` defaults to `medium` (`core/defaults.js`), so it is left out when the route says `medium`.
Each key is judged on its own, as the brief says. If a user sets `defaultProvider` but not `defaultModel`, setup still writes the route's model id next to their provider. Treating the pair as a unit would avoid that mismatch.
At project and local scope, a key the user's global file sets is left out, as for the other tool settings.
